info.title: assembly-differ: a dotnet tool to diff assemblies

commands.name: diff
commands.description:
Compares and diffs assemblies from different sources, outputting
differences in XML, Markdown, or AsciiDoc.

options.name: --target
options.description:
[repeatable] The assembly targets. Defaults to *all* assemblies located by the provider. May be
given more than once. [default: null]

options.name: --format
options.description: The format of the diff output: xml, markdown, or asciidoc. [default: xml]

options.name: --output
options.description: The output directory or file name. If not specified only prints to console. [default: null]

options.name: --prevent-change
options.description:
Fail if the change detected is higher than specified: none, patch, minor,
or major. Defaults to none, which never fails. [default: none]

options.name: --allow-empty-previous-nuget
options.description: Don't fail when no previous nuget package could be found to diff against.

arguments.name: FIRST
arguments.description:
Old assembly provider: assembly|<path>, directory|<path>, nuget|<id>|<version>|[tfm],
previous-nuget|<id>|<version>|[tfm], or github|<owner/repo>|<commit>|<build command>|<relative output path>.

arguments.name: SECOND
arguments.description: New assembly provider, same format as first.
